trans-unit.target: First segment of the gallery's public urls, e.g. "gallery" for /gallery/my-category. A change applies straight away, but the previous urls then return a not found page: set up a redirect if they were indexed. Left empty, the "gallery" prefix applies.

Off (default): the thumbnail fills its square, cropped from the centre, which hides the edges of a photo that is not square. On: the whole photo fits inside the square, the bands left around it taking the --gallery-thumb-background token's colour. The thumbnail file holds the whole photo either way, only the display changes: switching is immediate and regenerates nothing.
Color veiling the page behind the opened high resolution. Left empty, color-mix(in srgb, var(--black) 90%, transparent) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Background of the badge marking a thumbnail that opens a video player. Left empty, color-mix(in srgb, var(--black) 55%, transparent) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the triangle of the video badge. Left empty, var(--white), the theme's white applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the breadcrumb opening every page of the gallery. Left empty, color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 60%, var(--background)) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the credits and reserved rights shown under a media. Empty: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 60%, var(--background)) applies. A CSS color: hexadecimal with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or name.
Color of the passe-partout framing a displayed media. Left empty, var(--white), the theme's white applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the cross closing the lightbox. Left empty, var(--white), the theme's white applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Background of the cross closing the lightbox. Left empty, color-mix(in srgb, var(--black) 55%, transparent) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the chevron of the previous/next arrows sitting on the media. Left empty, var(--white), the theme's white applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Background of the previous/next arrow buttons. Left empty, color-mix(in srgb, var(--white) 80%, var(--black)) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the chevron on hover and on keyboard focus. Left empty, var(--gallery-nav-color), the arrows color applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
